lines.en: There is a knock at the door.
This happens sometimes.
Normally not with Futaba, though.
Apart from a few spare instances, she’s been one of the most careful of all.
That changes today.
The only question is who is intruding this time?
Another knock.
Can we wait them out?
Will the person on the other end simply go away if we wait for long enough?
: What...do we do?
: There are a few things we can do.
: I’d appreciate it if you would start naming them because I’m both extremely lightheaded and also...in a minor state of shock, I think?
: You said you didn’t notice being followed, right?
: Yeah?...
: Then, do you think one of the others got tired of waiting around and wants a piece of me too?
: I...uhh...maybe?
: But I’m not really...
: You want me all to yourself?
: Uh-huh...
: You think you’re good enough for that?
: I really hope you’re still in character and not being serious right now.
: Of course I’m “still in character.” I’m just not really sure how to handle this apart from either waiting until they go away, which clearly isn’t going to work, or letting them in as well.
: But we don’t even know who it is.
: Well, who do you want it to be?
: Henry Cavill.
: Who?
: Some...hot guy. He’s an actor.
: I doubt it’s him, Futaba. It has to be one of the girls. Besides, I wouldn’t want to share you with some other guy anyway.
: Sure. But I don’t want to share you with some other girl. So neither one of us is going to get what we want.
: Do you want to try hiding then?
: Where? This is a bathroom. There’s nowhere to hide.
I carefully slide Futaba back to the ground so she can straighten her dress out and...at least attempt to disguise the fact that I emptied myself into her several minutes ago.
The knocking goes on for another five minutes before I give in and decide to open the door.
But who I find on the other side is slightly unexpected. Especially since I didn’t see her with Futaba’s group when the two of us “snuck” away.
: Something suspicious is afoot here...
: What makes you say that, Molly?
: The fact that you are not wearing pants.
: Oh. Shit.
: Seriously, Sensei?! You had like five whole minutes to put them back on!
: Yeah, but you didn’t warn me. I’m much more used to having my pants off than on, so this is kind of your fault too.
: Then it’s true what the innkeeper says — that a knight’s been having his way with the farmer’s daughter.
: I thought your father was an architect, Futaba?
: I think she’s just...roleplaying like normal, Sensei.
: Is now really the best time be running around and unlocking h-scenes, Sir? Because you never know when you might encounter another player embarking on various side quests.
: Like me for example. I was merely minding my own business, scouring Tsukioka Manor for dungeons to crawl through when- what’s this? Screams coming from a nearby cave? I simply had to investigate.
: Sure. But you’re not delusional to the point where you’d hear those screams and not immediately interpret them as people having sex. You knew what you were walking into.
: Aye! And I am prepared for whatever it is that will happen to me next, Sir!
: Oh, god...
: Molly, did you really mean to...intrude? If you knew it was me in here with Sensei-
: Oh, that much was unknown to me. I had assumed the Supreme Overlord was in here with someone more...prone to engaging in illicit affairs at parties.
: L...Like who?
: Most others, honestly. This is rather unlike you, Xessaxia. But I appreciate the boldness and will allow you to carry your Christmas miracle over to our next session.
: Greaaaaat. What an...awesome reward in exchange for you now knowing that Sensei and I are...hanging out.
: Now?
: Wonderful. So you knew too, then. And, since you’re here, I’m assuming Sensei is...hanging out with you as well.
: Molly’s new to the harem.
: Aye! Which means it’s time for me to catch up! And what better place to fall deeper into corruption than a mysterious cave while being watched by a satyr?!
: Unless said satyr would rather take part in the festivities as well. Which I assume is quite unlikely given that she rolled a natural one on sexuality.
: Futaba?
: Wha- of course not. You said no to Henry Cavill, so it’s only fair that I-
: Got it. I’ll just take care of Molly next then.
: EYEAAHH?! S...SIR?!
: While I’m still in the room?!
: Yeah. You could use some time to recover, right?
: Well...yes! But I don’t think this is particularly comfortable for either one of us!

I lift Molly up and throw her onto some kind of dresser thing or...I don’t know. I’m sure there’s some fancier word for it that I don’t know about because I wasn’t privileged enough to grow up in a place like this.
However, I have managed to somehow claw my way to the top. So I’ve reached the point where I have no trouble reaping and tending to the crops others have painstakingly grown.
: Are you...are we going to, like...actually do it this time, Sir?
: No. I just came inside your friend and it’ll take me a little while to recharge. But that doesn’t mean I can’t figure out what to do with you.
: Tch. It’s always the farmer’s daughter. Just once, I’d like the knight to have his way with another traveler instead.
: Yes. Forgive me for having the audacity to have sex with Sensei where I thought no one would find us.
: A...Always check the stables?
: I thought this was a cave.
: Check...there too! The fact of the matter is, the two of you decided to have your tryst in a place that someone experienced in CG-hunting would surely-
: FiiiiIIIiIIIIiIIIIiiiiIINd?!!?!?! AaAAAaah! Sir!?
: I don’t really know why I thought you wouldn’t be the type to do something like this, Molly.
: D...D-Do what?! I was merely...hunting slimes when...this man seized me and...aaaAaaah!
I shift her panties to the side and slip two of my fingers inside of her.
I figure I won’t have to start slowly given that she’s surely “practiced” on herself before today.
Probably with me too if the voices that come and go are worth believing.
The monks are gone for now. The sounds that bounce off of the marble must have scared them away.
They’re plentiful now. Two felt so lonely, but three? This is how it should be. Even if one of them is only here reluctantly.
: So...what am I supposed to do now? Just wait?
: K...Kiss me...Xessaxia!
: No.
: Hah...haaah...it was...worth a shot! I’m taking...away your...Christmas miracle!
: Want to try talking dirty again, Futaba? You were getting really into it when it was just the two of us.
: To...who? You’re touching Molly, not me. Am I supposed to...narrate it? How does this work?
: I...think a little...narration would...be nice!
: Then, uhh...
: Used his hands to...bring pleasure to the...traveler...It was the only way to...satisfy his...curiosities and...uhh...lust?
: It sounds like I’m listening to an audio-book all of a sudden.
: Aaaah! Forget it! I’ll just go back to the party and cover for Molly or something!
: Enjoy the knight, you thief! I hope he...sees how evil you are and...can’t get hard because of it!
Futaba slams the door behind her and, presumably, runs down the hall to tear herself away from the now-screaming Molly MacCormack.
I reach over and lock the door behind her.
It never makes much of a difference, but at least it’ll prevent someone else from barging in while I’m stirring the insides of a small Irish girl with my fingers.
: Mmnghg! S...Sir! I’m sorry for...interrupting! I had assumed that...probability favored...the bisexuals!
: You knocked on the door expecting to find yourself in a threesome moments later?
: It was less of an...expectation and...more of a...wish!
: You’re that much of a pervert, huh?
: Hah...this should...come as no surprise to you...Sir!...

: We’ve...reached the point where...ngaaah...things like that are...bound to happen! The harem has...grown too large...for any one of us...to ever expect to get to you alone! So forgive me for...wanting to party up!
: But I suppose that...now I..aaAaaaAahhh...finally get to experience a...holiday tryst!
At least one that you’re conscious for.
: That feels...amazing, Sir...
: So much better...than when I do it!...
: And you do it a lot, don’t you?
: Yes...so often, Sir...I’m such a naughty girl...I’m so needy...I want it so bad...every day...every night...I can’t...be sated...Sir!
: What do you think about when you do it?
: That...ngah...depends...Sir!
: On what?
: On...whatever mood I’m in that day...
: Sometimes...I like to imagine myself...being used by a horde of goblins...
: And other days...that I’m the...regent queen of an ancient elven society...holding the head of an aspiring suitor between my legs...
: That is an extremely specific fantasy.
: It’s not...always like that, Sir...
: A lot of the time, I...aah...I just think about...exactly what I’m thinking right now...
: Which is?
: How I want you to bend me over and fuck my little brains out, S-
: HYAAAaAAaAAAH!!!~~~!!!~

I hear what I want to hear, so I give her what she wants to feel. Or a taste of it, at least, since I’m still awaiting my second or...third or...whatever wind I’m owed after blacking out and cumming inside of Futaba.
I care not about goblins or queens, just the fact that this tiny creature somehow gets off to thoughts of me.
That she’d do as I say and spread her legs to welcome me. That she’d look me in the eyes and make me feel that, for once, I am the fantasy she’s lost in.
That she’d do it all looking like this. Adorable, yet trapped in ecstasy as she squirms under my touch.
It’s the type of temptation I would never be able to hold myself back from — even when I tell myself I can.
Or I did.
Or I didn’t.
She is a gem of far more than just the Emerald Isle.

: Doesn’t matter. Point is, she’s gone. You’re not. Now get on your knees and make me hard again.

: I don’t care if you’ll be gone after tonight. You’re what I have now, so I’m going to need you to be productive in some capacity. Pareidolia was an asshole, but at least he got things done.
